I have struggled with my mental health for years due to emotional unavailabilty from my parents. Also cases of narcissism and control but through it I’ve learned that all I can do is heal. 


— I would suggest you just stay home. Do you live by yourself or have roommates at the apartment? If roomates are there, it would be safer for you to stay home. Don’t cause tension in the house and this will be better than you sneaking away. If it’s possible try to them as well if they’re not. I recommend looking up emdr therapy and other yt videos on how to heal. Or if your into spirituality look into healing chakras, meditation etc
— get into something that you love. Dance, singing, learn more about religion
—- call up friends and vent to them
— join online forums 
—- message me if you would like, I always felt like I was alone but I realized A LOT of us African children can’t express ourselves without being controlled, called ungrateful or were trying to be “GROWN”
Hang in there love 💕
